theorems.name: Submission.cbr_ci_cp_eval_eq_orthonormal_frame
theorems.statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (ζ₀ : MultiVector P (d + 1)) (V : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), Module.finrank ℝ V ≤ d + 1 → (∀ β : Covector (Euclid P) (d + 1), |ζ₀ β| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm β) → (∃ β : Covector (Euclid P) (d + 1), covectorEuclideanNorm β ≤ 1 ∧ ζ₀ β = 1) → (∀ β : Covector (Euclid P) (d + 1), ζ₀ β = ζ₀ (β.compContinuousLinearMap V.starProjection)) → Module.finrank ℝ V = d + 1 ∧ ∃ v : Fin (d + 1) → Euclid P, Orthonormal ℝ v ∧ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range v) = V ∧ ∀ β : Covector (Euclid P) (d + 1), ζ₀ β = β v
